props.gloss_en: David calls himself pious: 'keep my soul, for I am pious' (Ps 86:2)
account 1: David's piety is that while all the kings of East and West sleep until the third hour, he rises at midnight to give thanks (Ps 119:62)
account 2, first ground: while the kings sit in their honoured groups, David's hands are soiled with blood, foetus and afterbirth to purify a woman for her husband
account 2, second ground: moreover, whatever David does he consults Mefiboshet his teacher -- did I judge, convict, acquit, purify, defile rightly? -- and is not ashamed
the verse for account 2: 'and I will speak of Your testimonies before kings and will not be ashamed' (Ps 119:46)
his name was not Mefiboshet but Ish Boshet
he is called Mefiboshet because he would shame David's face in halakha
therefore David merited that Kilav issue from him
R' Yochanan: his name was not Kilav but Daniel
he is called Kilav because he would shame Mefiboshet's face in halakha
of Kilav Solomon said 'my son, if your heart is wise, my heart will be glad, even mine' (Prov 23:15) and 'be wise, my son, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him who taunts me' (Prov 27:11)
the tanna in R' Yosei's name: the dots on לולא (Ps 27:13) teach that David said: I am sure You reward the righteous in the world to come, but I do not know whether I have a portion among them
the answer: David's doubt about his portion was not doubt of his piety -- he feared lest sin cause [forfeit of it]
R' Yaakov bar Idi set 'I am with you and will guard you' (Gen 28:15) against 'and Jacob feared greatly' (Gen 32:8) and resolved: Jacob said, lest sin cause [forfeit of the promise]
'until Your people cross, Lord' (Ex 15:16) is the first entry into the Land
'until the people You acquired cross' is the second entry
the Sages: Israel deserved a miracle in Ezra's days as in Joshua's, but sin caused [its absence]

supports.gloss_en: מאי קרא -- ואדברה בעדתיך נגד מלכים ולא אבוש: David speaks of Torah before kings and is not ashamed
כדרבי יעקב בר אידי -- as Jacob, promised protection, still feared lest sin cause its forfeit, so David
כדתניא: עד יעבר עמך ה' עד יעבר עם זו קנית -- two entries; Israel deserved a miracle in Ezra's days too, אלא שגרם החטא
